title: Security event catalog and coverage report
description: Versioned catalog of security event types (authentication, authorization denials, privilege and role changes, data reads and exports, configuration changes, administrative and break-glass actions, database-level activity, agent actions) mapped to emitting components, with automated coverage tests proving each event is emitted with required fields.

title: Log integrity verification results
description: Periodic verification of hash chains or signed checkpoints over authoritative audit history and security logs, detecting omitted, altered, duplicated or reordered records, including after restore.
signing: Proposed: signed checkpoints anchored outside the production trust domain
notes: UNB-DATA-012 leaves the mechanism (hash chain, signed checkpoint or other) as a design decision to be benchmarked.

title: Log retention and legal hold configuration evidence
description: Effective retention settings per log class and tenant, legal holds, and deletion or redaction events for personal data, generated from the storage configuration.

title: Alert and response metrics
description: Alerts by severity with time to acknowledge and time to contain, after-hours handling, escalation records and protective actions taken.

title: Detection catalog and detection test results
description: Versioned detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and domain abuse cases, with seeded-event test results showing each detection fires, and false positive rates.

title: Tenant audit trail export
description: Customer-accessible export or stream of tenant-scoped audit events, including Echelon personnel and break-glass actions, with integrity proofs that the customer can verify independently.

title: Missing heartbeat and evidence completeness record
description: Expected-evidence schedule reconciled against received logs and control heartbeats; every missing or late source raises a preserved deficiency, and zero-activity periods carry independently validated zero-activity evidence.
notes: Specified in unbound@9b38de47:architecture/CONTINUOUS-CONTROL-MONITORING-AND-EVIDENCE-ASSURANCE.md (Missing evidence algorithm); not implemented.

title: AI agent activity ledger
description: Per agent action: agent identity, model and version, authorizing human or policy, task id, tool invoked, parameters (redacted per classification), resource, result, denial events and kill-switch events.
producer: Praxis (records agent provenance for repository work; runtime agent ledger for Unbound not built)

title: Time synchronization status
description: Clock offset measurements per log-producing host or service against authoritative time sources, with alerts on drift beyond tolerance.

title: Privileged and break-glass session records
description: Break-glass activations with two-person approval, session records, tenant administrator notifications and post-session review outcomes; CI and deployment pipeline change records.
